name: datacenter-atlas
description: Open, evidence-backed dataset and map of data-centre construction worldwide: every site cited to dated primary sources. CSV, GeoJSON, SQLite, KML downloads and a static JSON API; CC BY 4.0.

paragraphs: Data Center Atlas is an open, evidence-backed dataset of data-centre construction worldwide. Public information about where data centres are being built is scattered across company disclosures, government records and filings, and is often vague about location and timing. The atlas keeps only projects with a dated, authoritative report of physical construction work and a reviewed locator whose precision is stated, and it links each status, locator and typed value to its source, with retrieval times, content hashes and licences. Unknown values stay unknown, and nothing is inferred to make a…
